prompts.title: 微缩世界般的建筑平面图
prompts.description: 一个复杂的提示，用于生成一张图像，该图像将建筑平面图可视化为铺展在绘图桌上的形式，其中空间向上延伸形成可居住的微缩房间，展示了人类活动瞬间和技术细节，如 HVAC（供热通风与空调）和交通流线模式，同时融合了平面图和 3D 模型。
prompts.content: An architectural floor plan of {BUILDING_TYPE} spread across a drafting table, with the spaces rising into inhabitable miniature. {ROOM_1} emerges with {FURNITURE_1} and {ACTIVITY_1} in progress, {ROOM_2} rises with {DESIGN_ELEMENT} and {HUMAN_MOMENT}, {ROOM_3} pushes up with {DETAIL_1} and {LIGHTING_1}. Walls exist as both lines and actual partitions simultaneously. Sight lines marked on the plan become actual views between spaces. The mechanical systems in the plan—HVAC, plumbing, electrical—pulse with invisible function. Human circulation patterns appear as ghosted movement trails. Architectural scale figures become actual tiny inhabitants living their tiny lives. Section cuts reveal vertical relationships. The architect's tools surround: scales, pencils, trace paper. Golden design studio light, the plan as promise and proof, 8K, architecture as life container.

prompts.content: Use the uploaded photos as the ONLY appearance standards: keep the faces of both people 1:1 (features, proportions, age, skin tone, hair color/length), without changing their appearance even by 1%, without enhancing, without facial retouching. Ultra-realistic film fashion shoot of the couple (35mm film photo), streetwear aesthetics, "caught on film". Location: an empty concrete pool/skate pool with smooth curves (empty pool bowl), worn paint in blue and mint shades, signs of use and light dirt are visible, night-time atmosphere. Frame: vertical 3:4, tilted composition (slight Dutch angle), medium shot. The couple is positioned diagonally in the frame. Pose (important): the guy is sitting by the wall of the pool, his back leaning against the edge and looking at the camera. The girl is lying on top of the edge, her head hanging down next to the guy's head (their heads almost touching). The girl's hair hangs loosely down. The mood is calm, slightly detached. Images: identical white oversized streetwear sweatshirts with large black text and a red graphic element on the chest (no specific brands/logos), identical neutral light-colored shorts/bottoms, minimalism. Lighting: hard flash to the forehead (direct on-camera flash), strong shadows and sharp contrast, "snapshot" aesthetic, bright highlights on the skin and fabric, darker background. prompts.title: 奢华藤条香薰产品摄影提示
prompts.description: 一个超现实的提示词，用于高端产品摄影，重点是一款深色黑曜石玻璃藤条香薰瓶，配有金属金色标签。场景富有戏剧性和电影感，以凝结的水珠、深绯色玫瑰和茂盛的植物为特色，采用低调照明和浅景深，营造出奢华香氛广告的氛围。
prompts.content:
Ultra-realistic premium product photography of a deep obsidian glass reed diffuser bottle labeled “MIDNIGHT OUD – Signature Reserve – NOIRÉ” in refined metallic gold serif lettering. The bottle features a tall, softly rounded square silhouette with beveled edges and a high-gloss mirror finish. A subtle embossed gold crest logo is positioned near the upper center, adding an understated luxury detail. Slim matte charcoal diffuser reeds rise elegantly from the neck.
The glass surface is coated with lifelike condensation and scattered water droplets, as though captured moments after a cool mist. The diffuser is nestled among dark crimson roses and scattered plum-toned petals, layered with lush emerald foliage that glistens with moisture. The setting feels rich and atmospheric, with a shadowy botanical backdrop softly fading into blur (shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh).
Lighting is dramatic and cinematic, featuring low-key illumination with gentle rim lighting to accentuate the curves of the bottle. Subtle cool hues, deep forest greens and midnight navy tones, create a mysterious, high-end ambiance. Metallic typography and the embossed crest catch delicate highlights for a sophisticated, luxury fragrance campaign feel.
Composition: Vertical 4:5 portrait ratio, hero product centered and slightly angled for dimension. Foreground florals subtly frame the base of the bottle, while background foliage dissolves into darkness.
Texture focus: Ultra-detailed condensation beads, reflective lacquered glass, velvety rose textures, and soft matte reeds.
Style: Luxury home fragrance advertising, macro photography aesthetic, 85mm lens, f/2 aperture, razor-sharp focus on product, dramatic contrast, rich shadows, ultra-photorealistic 8K detail, premium editorial finish.
prompts.translatedContent:
超逼真的高端产品摄影，展示了一个深色黑曜石玻璃藤条香薰瓶，瓶身标有“MIDNIGHT OUD – Signature Reserve – NOIRÉ”，采用精致的金属金色衬线字体。瓶子呈高挑、柔和圆润的方形轮廓，边缘经过斜面处理，并具有高光镜面效果。瓶身上方中央附近有一个微妙的浮雕金色徽章标志，增添了低调的奢华感。纤细的哑光炭灰色香薰藤条优雅地从瓶颈伸出。

玻璃表面覆盖着逼真的冷凝水和零星的水珠，仿佛是在凉爽的薄雾之后捕捉到的瞬间。香薰瓶被深红色玫瑰和散落的梅子色花瓣簇拥着，层叠着翠绿的茂盛植物，植物上闪烁着湿润的光泽。整个场景营造出一种丰富而富有氛围感的感觉，阴影中的植物背景柔和地淡入模糊（浅景深，奶油般散景）。

灯光效果富有戏剧性和电影感，采用低调照明，并辅以柔和的轮廓光，以突出瓶身的曲线。微妙的冷色调、深森林绿和午夜海军蓝，营造出神秘、高端的氛围。金属字体和浮雕徽章捕捉到精致的高光，带来一种精致奢华的香水广告大片感。

构图：垂直 4:5 肖像比例，核心产品居中并略微倾斜以增加立体感。前景花卉巧妙地勾勒出瓶底，而背景植物则融入黑暗。

纹理焦点：超精细的冷凝水珠、反光的漆面玻璃、天鹅绒般的玫瑰纹理和柔软的哑光藤条。

风格：奢华家居香氛广告、微距摄影美学、85mm 镜头、f/2 光圈、产品锐利对焦、戏剧性对比、丰富阴影、超逼真 8K 细节、高端编辑级效果。

prompts.title: Z 世代情人节卧室场景提示
prompts.description: 一个超现实的提示，用于生成一个时尚、舒适的 Z 世代情人节场景：一对时尚情侣在黄金时段凌乱的床上，捕捉到女人拍摄“和我一起准备”视频时的真实电影瞬间。
prompts.content:
Create a hyper-realistic, trendy Gen Z Valentine’s Day scene inside a cozy, aesthetic bedroom during late afternoon golden hour.
The room has soft pastel walls, fairy lights, heart-shaped wall décor, polaroid photos, plush pillows, and scattered fashion magazines. Natural sunlight streams through sheer curtains, casting warm golden light across the space.
A stylish young couple sits casually on a messy bed covered with white and blush blankets.
The man wears relaxed streetwear — oversized hoodie, loose jeans, layered chains, soft curls slightly messy.
The woman wears an oversized pink sweater with knee-high socks, natural dewy makeup, glossy lips, and soft waves in her hair.
She holds a phone up as if filming a “Get Ready With Me – Valentine Edition” video while he leans in from behind, smiling playfully at the camera. They look relaxed, flirty, and authentic — candid but cinematic.
Heart-shaped balloons rest on the floor, and a glowing pink LED sign reading “Be Mine” is mounted on the wall.
Lighting: warm natural golden hour light + soft fairy light glow.
Lens: 35mm lifestyle lens, shallow depth of field, creamy background blur.
Style: ultra-detailed, soft skin texture, cozy influencer aesthetic, TikTok vibe, romantic but modern, candid editorial photography.
prompts.translatedContent:
在午后黄金时段，在一个舒适、有格调的卧室里，营造一个超现实、时尚的 Z 世代情人节场景。

房间里有柔和的马卡龙色墙壁、小彩灯、心形墙面装饰、拍立得照片、毛绒枕头和散落的时尚杂志。自然阳光透过薄纱窗帘洒进来，给整个空间镀上了一层温暖的金色光芒。

一对时尚的年轻情侣随意地坐在铺着白色和腮红毯子的凌乱床上。

男士穿着休闲街头服饰——宽松的连帽衫、宽松的牛仔裤、叠戴的项链，柔软的卷发略显凌乱。

女士穿着一件宽松的粉色毛衣，搭配及膝袜，化着自然的露水感妆容，涂着亮泽的唇彩，头发是柔和的波浪卷。

她举着手机，仿佛正在拍摄一个“和我一起准备——情人节特辑”的视频，而他则从她身后探过身来，对着镜头俏皮地笑着。他们看起来放松、调情且真实——既自然又富有电影感。

心形气球散落在地板上，墙上挂着一个发光的粉色 LED 标牌，上面写着“Be Mine”。

灯光：温暖自然的黄金时段光线 + 柔和的小彩灯光芒。
镜头：35mm 生活镜头，浅景深，奶油般柔和的背景虚化。
风格：超细节、柔和的皮肤纹理、舒适的网红美学、TikTok 氛围、浪漫而现代、真实的杂志摄影。

prompts.title: 萨迪·辛克红毯晚会肖像
prompts.description: 一个结构化的提示，用于生成萨迪·辛克 (Sadie Sink) 在红毯晚会上的中景肖像，她身穿优雅的黑色礼服，配有精致的蕾丝覆盖，面带浅笑，在白色花卉布置的模糊背景下，采用电影工作室灯光。
